# ABQ.Coffee

> ABQ.Coffee is a premium, exact-match city + category domain for Albuquerque coffee brands — cafes, roasters, and coffee carts. Available for acquisition at $100,000 USD via Escrow.com.

The site is an informational brand concept for the name plus a domain acquisition listing.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://abq.coffee/): brand concept, high-desert positioning, buyer FAQ, and domain inquiry form.
- [Insights](https://abq.coffee/insights/): guides on high-altitude brewing, the Albuquerque coffee scene, and coffee brand naming.
- [Domain offer](https://abq.coffee/#acquisition): asking price, escrow terms, and inquiry form.

## Contact

- Sales: sales@desertrich.com
- Escrow: https://www.escrow.com
